system.longDesc: You react to threats speedily and instinctively.

degree0.desc: You can prepare yourself for action in an instant. Once per round, you can use Ready as a free action on your turn.

degree1.desc: You can flip yourself up or drop down with lightning speed. You can go prone or stand up as a free action. (These normally can be done only as part of a Move action.)

degree2.desc: It is hard to get the drop on you. You may re-roll your initiative roll at the start of a combat encounter, but you must keep the results of the second roll.
